title: test(backend): bind Article Vault execution source lock to compiled behavior
body:
Parent: #3551. Depends on #3558 / PR #3559 for the compiled metadata inspector. This is the separate ArticleVaultExecutionTests owner; do not combine with asset, manifest or export owners.

Current master has five production-source-read findings in tests/backend/Unit/ArticleVaultExecutionTests.cs under ExecutionSource_HasNoFilesystemWatcherImportOrDirectArticleMutationSidePath, plus other source reads in that same method. It reads ArticleVault executor, ArticleService writer, transaction, mutation and lifecycle source text.

## Exact acceptance

- Replace this method's production-source and directory reads with compiled production method/type evidence and executable boundary assertions. Retain the no direct filesystem/watch/import path, no direct article SQL mutation side path, canonical CreateMutationAsync/UpdateAsync/DeleteAsync routing, foreground-write and public-fence/rollback requirements.
- Keep existing Article Vault execution and refusal tests; bind to production assemblies, not copied test fixtures or source syntax. Do not claim lexical import absence from IL; verify equivalent executable ownership and report that boundary accurately.
- No product runtime, wire/ABI, checker, threshold, generated output or unrelated owner change. The stacked candidate removes this owner's five findings with no new finding.
- Run focused owner tests, scanner positive/refusal suite, C# style, matrix structure and exact-head PR contract. If a required runtime gate cannot execute on this host, keep the PR draft and record exact failure. Retarget/revalidate against master after #3559 merges. Local green does not authorize merge.
